import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (minimizes tip damage)
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

# Start scan (from bottom to top)
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished")

# Get the file path of the last scanned image
try:
    gallery_count = application.GetGalleryItemCount()
    print(f"Gallery item count: {gallery_count}")
    
    if gallery_count > 0:
        # Get the last item (most recent scan)
        last_item = application.GetGalleryItem(gallery_count - 1)
        file_path = last_item.FileName
        print(f"Image saved at: {file_path}")
        print(f"Absolute path: {os.path.abspath(file_path)}")
    else:
        print("No items in gallery")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting file path: {e}")
    # Try alternative method
    try:
        file_path = scan.FileName
        print(f"Image file path (from scan object): {file_path}")
    except:
        print("Could not retrieve file path")

del spm"}</action_input>
